verdicts.reason: A rearranges sensibly for the banner, with the can on the left and the quote on the right, and keeps the attribution close under the quote. But the quote is small for 300x250, the large maroon circle sits behind the text block so the right side feels muddy, and the tiny SOLSTICE logo floats by itself at bottom-left. B uses the same structure but leaves a loose gap between the quote and the attribution, which weakens the grouping. Its left circle also sits low and crowds the small logo, which almost touches the circle's lower edge, so the bottom-left feels jammed while the top-left is empty.
